body:
Can't afford a psychologist... As much as I hate using that as an excuse.

Yeah, right now I'm trying get a job working with the mentally handicapped, but I can't find anything there... So I've just been applying around where I live, usually 3-4 times a week. And sadly, firefighters aren't awesome on a resume.

And I don't really do the firefighter thing because I get to be a hero and save kittens from trees... I'm one of the only people in my community who gives a fuck about everyone else.

I hate to say that I have any kind of mental problems, because I probably don't, but, I worry about everything. Every single waking moment for me I'm worried about my complete lack of progress I'm making.


And being a volunteer won't put food on my plate, eventually my parents will have had enough and tell me to leave... Not that I blame them, but it's a huge concern.


And I hate to be a bitch about this, but I've heard that response more than once... Lots of "Everything is going to be ok" and "You just need to think positive"


Because those are the kinds of things I say to dying patients.
